fields.label: P: Le Shelter Foundation, in partnership with New J
fields.value: Le Shelter Foundation, in partnership with New Jerusalem Baptist Church, successfully carried out the Bright Spaces, Brighter Minds outreach initiative in Apewosika, Cape Coast. The project brought together volunteers, community leaders, and supporters with a shared goal of empowering children and strengthening the local community through education, mentorship, and engagement activities. The initiative focused on addressing the challenges faced by students at the Apewosika Methodist Primary School, particularly the need for supportive learning environments, mentorship opportunities, and social development programs. Many students in the area have limited access to resources and activities that encourage creativity, confidence, and personal growth. Through this outreach, the organizations aimed to create meaningful experiences that inspired hope and encouraged positive development among students.

The project brought together volunteers, community leaders, and supporters with a shared goal of empowering children and strengthening the local community through education, mentorship, and engagement activities. The initiative focused on addressing the challenges faced by students at the Apewosika Methodist Primary School, particularly the need for supportive learning environments, mentorship opportunities, and social development programs. Many students in the area have limited access to resources and activities that encourage creativity, confidence, and personal growth. Through this outreach, the organizations aimed to create meaningful experiences that inspired hope and encouraged positive development among students.

fields.label: P: During the outreach program, volunteers organize
fields.value: During the outreach program, volunteers organized interactive educational sessions, mentorship activities, community engagement exercises, and recreational programs for the students. Essential items and learning materials were also provided to support the participants and contribute to their educational journey. The atmosphere throughout the event was filled with excitement, encouragement, and a strong sense of community collaboration. One of the major highlights of the initiative was the Painting of some classroom blocks, showcasing the active participation of community members and volunteers who dedicated their time and resources to ensure the success of the program. The partnership between Le Shelter Foundation and New Jerusalem Baptist Church demonstrated the impact that collaboration and compassion can have in transforming lives and creating opportunities for underserved communities.

fields.label: P: Asiafo Amanfro M/A School, situated in a growing
fields.value: Asiafo Amanfro M/A School, situated in a growing peri-urban community, faces challenges such as its distance from residential areas, limited educational resources, and inadequate infrastructure. As the area continues to develop, the school must adapt to the evolving needs of students while depending on government support. Recognizing these challenges, Le Shelter Foundation initiated an intervention to enhance learning conditions, promote student development, and improve the overall educational experience.
fields.default: Asiafo Amanfro M/A School, situated in a growing peri-urban community, faces challenges such as its distance from residential areas, limited educational resources, and inadequate infrastructure. As the area continues to develop, the school must adapt to the evolving needs of students while depending on government support. Recognizing these challenges, Le Shelter Foundation initiated an intervention to enhance learning conditions, promote student development, and improve the overall educational experience.

fields.label: P: Le Shelter Foundation’s visit to Asiafo Amanfro
fields.value: Le Shelter Foundation’s visit to Asiafo Amanfro M/A School featured a series of impactful interventions aimed at enhancing education and school facilities. Through interactive workshops including science experiments, creative arts, and soap-making; students were encouraged to develop creativity, teamwork, and critical thinking. Educational discussions on hygiene and academic success provided essential life skills, while motivational talks by industry professionals inspired students to broaden their career aspirations. Additionally, minor infrastructure repairs, such as toilet refurbishments, improved the school’s facilities. To ensure long-term benefits, Le Shelter Foundation donated educational kits, provided a fuel-powered grass-cutting machine for school maintenance, and introduced a structured mentorship program to support students in their academic and personal growth.

Recognizing these challenges, Le Shelter Foundation initiated an intervention to improve student well-being and foster a supportive learning environment.

fields.label: P: Tucked away in the heart of Samraboi, a remote c
fields.value: Tucked away in the heart of Samraboi, a remote cocoa farming village in Ghana’s Western Region, Ayensukrom M/A School has long stood as a symbol of perseverance amid adversity. For years, students and teachers braved crumbling classroom walls, sat on broken desks, and studied without basic learning materials-determined to pursue education against all odds. The journey to school itself, over deeply eroded, unpaved roads, was a daily struggle. Yet despite these overwhelming challenges, the spirit of this school community remained unbroken.

For years, students and teachers braved crumbling classroom walls, sat on broken desks, and studied without basic learning materials-determined to pursue education against all odds. The journey to school itself, over deeply eroded, unpaved roads, was a daily struggle. Yet despite these overwhelming challenges, the spirit of this school community remained unbroken.

fields.label: P: That resilience was recently rewarded through a
fields.value: That resilience was recently rewarded through a gesture of compassion and solidarity. Thanks to a significant and timely donation from our dedicated partners, Ayensukrom M/A School has begun to witness a long-overdue transformation-one that has renewed hope, restored dignity, and reignited dreams marking a turning point in the school’s journey. Additionally, students received new books, writing supplies, and other essential educational resources, while teachers were equipped with improved teaching materials. This intervention has brought more than just physical changes-it has restored confidence, motivation, and a renewed sense of pride within the school. We extend our deepest gratitude to the donors whose generosity has brought lasting change to Ayensukrom M/A School. Your support has not only improved a school’s infrastructure but uplifted an entire community.
